`/work/cam_0579.lean` now compiles with no errors. The only output is a deprecation warning for `Set.mem_setOf_eq`. I replaced the single `sorry` with a proof and changed nothing else.

The proof reduces both directions to one-variable functions `g(s) = f(a + s•z)`:

- **Hessian form as a second derivative.** The double sum equals `fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) y z z`, the second derivative of `f` at `y` applied to `z` twice. I get this by expanding `z` in the basis `Pi.single i 1` and using that `f` is twice differentiable on `C`. From this, `g' (s) = fderiv ℝ f (a + s•z) z` and `g''(s)` is the double sum at `a + s•z`.
- **Forward direction.** If `f` is convex on `C`, then `g` is convex on the open convex set `{s | x + s•z ∈ C}`, which contains 0. So `deriv g` is monotone there, and `g''(0)` (the Hessian form at `x`) is nonnegative.
- **Reverse direction.** For `a, b ∈ C`, put `z = b - a` and apply `convexOn_of_deriv2_nonneg` to `g` on `[0, 1]`. The hypothesis gives `g'' ≥ 0` on the interior, so `g` is convex there. Evaluating at the weights `p, q` gives the convexity inequality for `f`.

There are no added axioms, and the file contains no `sorry`.
